# PHPUnit method-start coverage fixture

Generated with PHPUnit 11.5.55, PHP 8.4.26 and Xdebug 3.5.3. The Clover XML
is the actual writer output. `lines.json` was generated by
`phpunit-test/export-lines.php` from the same run's `--coverage-php` output.
Paths are intentionally retained from the generating workspace.

To regenerate, place `Methods.php` in `moodle/local/mxsdk/classes` and
`MethodsTest.php` in `tests` (adjust its require path), then run:

```sh
XDEBUG_MODE=coverage php phpunit.phar --no-configuration \
  --coverage-filter moodle/local/mxsdk/classes \
  --coverage-clover clover.xml --coverage-php raw.php --coverage-text tests
php /path/to/phpunit-test/export-lines.php phpunit.phar raw.php lines.json
```

Native totals are 2/3 executable lines. Clover represents lines 4 and 5 only
as methods; line 6 is a non-executable declaration despite its method count.
